title: Alpine Serenity Escape
summary: Experience the peaceful beauty of Lake Bled, surrounded by the Julian Alps. Discover its charming island, historic castle and scenic lakeside trails.
highlights: Traditional boat ride to Bled Island
Panoramic views of the Julian Alps
Taste the famous Bled cream cake

itinerary.title: Arrival in Lake Bled
itinerary.description: Arrive in Bled, check in and spend the evening exploring the lakeside promenade. Enjoy the mountain scenery and local cuisine.

itinerary.title: Island and Castle Exploration
itinerary.description: Take a traditional pletna boat to Bled Island and visit its Church of the Assumption. Later, explore Bled Castle overlooking the lake.

itinerary.title: Nature and Scenic Trails
itinerary.description: Explore the viewpoints around Lake Bled or take an excursion to nearby Vintgar Gorge. Enjoy the surrounding alpine landscape.

itinerary.title: Leisure and Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy a relaxed morning, sample local Bled cream cake and prepare for departure.

title: Phuket Tropical Getaway
summary: Escape to the tropical beaches of Phuket. Enjoy turquoise waters, island excursions, beautiful coastal viewpoints and the colourful atmosphere of Phuket Old Town.
highlights: Relax at Kata or Karon Beach
Experience Thai food and night markets

itinerary.title: Welcome to Phuket
itinerary.description: Arrive in Phuket, check in and enjoy a relaxed evening exploring the nearby beach and local restaurants.

itinerary.title: Beaches and Coastal Views
itinerary.description: Explore Kata and Karon beaches. Continue towards Promthep Cape for scenic coastal views and a memorable sunset.

itinerary.title: Island Adventure and Old Town
itinerary.description: Choose an optional island-hopping experience or spend the day exploring Phuket Old Town, its colourful architecture, cafés and markets.

itinerary.title: Leisure and Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and some free time before checkout and departure.

title: Plitvice Waterfall Adventure
summary: Discover the spectacular lakes and waterfalls of Plitvice Lakes National Park. Walk through forest trails, cross wooden pathways and experience one of Croatia's remarkable natural landscapes.
highlights: Explore the Upper and Lower Lakes
Optional electric boat ride across Lake Kozjak

itinerary.title: Arrival and Nature Retreat
itinerary.description: Arrive near Plitvice Lakes, check in and enjoy a relaxed evening surrounded by the natural scenery of the region.

itinerary.title: Lower Lakes Exploration
itinerary.description: Explore the Lower Lakes, limestone canyon pathways and the impressive Great Waterfall. Stop at scenic viewpoints along the route.

itinerary.title: Upper Lakes and Forest Trails
itinerary.description: Discover the Upper Lakes, wooded surroundings and smaller waterfalls. Enjoy an optional electric boat ride across Lake Kozjak.

itinerary.title: Morning Leisure and Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy a relaxed breakfast and a final opportunity to appreciate the surrounding landscape before departure.

title: Vienna Imperial Heritage
summary: Step into Vienna's imperial past with a visit to Schönbrunn Palace, its magnificent gardens and the city's historic streets, museums and architectural landmarks.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Vienna
itinerary.description: Arrive in Vienna, check in and explore the historic city centre. Enjoy its architecture, cafés and lively streets.

itinerary.title: Schönbrunn Palace Experience
itinerary.description: Visit Schönbrunn Palace and explore its imperial interiors and expansive gardens. Walk towards the Gloriette for views across the palace grounds.

itinerary.title: Vienna City Highlights
itinerary.description: Explore central Vienna, including St. Stephen's Cathedral and nearby historic streets. Enjoy a relaxed café visit before departure.

title: Algarve Coastal Escape
summary: Discover the dramatic coastline of Portugal's Algarve region. Explore golden beaches, rugged limestone formations, sea caves and charming coastal towns.
highlights: Discover the old town of Lagos

itinerary.title: Arrival in Lagos
itinerary.description: Arrive in Lagos and explore its historic centre, traditional streets and waterfront. Enjoy the relaxed atmosphere of the Algarve coast.

itinerary.title: Coastal Cliffs and Beaches
itinerary.description: Visit Ponta da Piedade and admire its striking rock formations. Continue to Praia Dona Ana and enjoy the coastal scenery.

itinerary.title: Coastal Leisure and Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy a relaxed morning or an optional boat excursion along the coast before checkout and departure.

title: Singapore City Explorer
summary: Experience the energy of Singapore through its iconic skyline, waterfront attractions, cultural neighbourhoods and spectacular gardens.
highlights: Enjoy the Supertree Grove light show

itinerary.title: Welcome to Singapore
itinerary.description: Arrive in Singapore and explore the Marina Bay waterfront. Visit Merlion Park and enjoy the evening city skyline.

itinerary.title: Gardens and City Attractions
itinerary.description: Discover Gardens by the Bay, including the Supertree Grove and optional conservatory visits. Enjoy the evening light and music show.

itinerary.title: Cultural Exploration and Departure
itinerary.description: Explore Chinatown and nearby heritage landmarks. Enjoy some free time before checkout and departure.
